title: ChatGPT Plus Free for Researchers! 🎓
body: OpenAI has expanded its program for academic researchers to reach 200,000 researchers, and the new round opens on 23 November, offering 50,000 grants on a first-come basis — each grant covers the researcher and two of their colleagues.
Since July, 20,000 researchers from 33 countries have joined, and program data is not used for training by default.
Know a researcher who deserves the grant? Share this post with them! 👇
